svg.aria-label: design: Design from references, scored by a critic. Four sub-skills: core, flow, banner-design, thumbnail-keyart. Steps: core, principles, taste, a scored loop; flow, Figma screens with their flow; banner-design, brand side, four jobs, a CTA; thumbnail-keyart, a game in one frame, read back blind. Output: a design that passes the critic and the bench, not the author.
